decisions.reason: The centered-shaft and stable whisk-rotation impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The source's high-speed splash mitigation impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including overall layout.
The smooth, non-abrupt, splash-free valve-opening impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The power-supply capacity check concerns component ratings under load and does not necessarily change the requested basic wiring-plan deliverable.
References to layout are mitigation options for the separate splash-control behavior and do not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable itself.
Pre-order compatibility checks do not alter the existing policy of using off-the-shelf components where practical.
The source mentions bowl depth only as a splash-control factor and does not change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance.
A controlled splash-free pour and electrical load check do not change the existing leak-containment requirements.
The source reiterates smooth, non-aggressive high-speed mixing already present in the candidate state and establishes no new mixing-quality value.
The source does not change the spout's removability, flushing, or cleaning requirements.
The compatibility checks have no effect on the machine's beige and green color scheme.
The compatibility checks have no effect on branding text or placard placement.
